title: AIF-mediated caspase-independent necroptosis requires ATM and DNA-PK-induced histone H2AX Ser139 phosphorylation

grounded.evidence_quote: The generation of double-strand breaks (DSBs) is related to the phosphorylation of the H2AX C-terminal tail at Ser139 that yields γH2AX.
Moreover, histone H2AX is activated/phosphorylated after MNNG treatment, providing a mark of DSBs DNA damage: γH2AX.
MNNG addition generates double-strand breaks in DNA (1) and subsequent ATM/DNA-PK activation.
grounded.location: CAPTION: Representation of MNNG-induced caspase-independent necroptosis.

grounded.evidence_quote: Kinetics of the DNA-PK Ser2053 phosphorylation induced by MNNG in MEFs.
grounded.location: CAPTION: ATM and DNA-PK phosphorylate at Ser1981 and Ser2053, respectively, to regulate MNNG-induced γH2AX generation.

grounded.evidence_quote: Indeed, compared with control cells, ATR appears a bit less phosphorylated after MNNG treatment (Figure 4a).
grounded.location: Simultaneous inhibition of ATM and DNA-PK, not ATR or JNK, abolishes H2AX phosphorylation in MNNG-induced necroptosis
